feature_contract.goal: Connect actual game D3D9 programmable SM3 declarations, mixed packed/float vertex register conversion, IA upload and full-size native Draw/DrawIndexed while keeping opt-in fallback and original source ordinal.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Translate source-owned game D3DCOLOR, integer, normalized, half and float attributes into exact D3D11 shader registers and real native Draw/DrawIndexed.
Fail closed for unsupported declaration, stream, truncated attributes, oversized GPU vertex bytes and out-of-range indices; preserve original D3D9 Draw/input/FFB.
DX11 Fast, Backend Conversion, Windows Build, OpenXR and HUD Inspector mandatory Actions all succeed on one exact SHA, without inferring gameplay/HMD parity.

integration_path: D3D9 live SM3 declaration and VB/IB/UP shadow
CPU typed game attribute unpack and semantic register mapping
Native D3D11 IA upload Draw/DrawIndexed and guarded full-resolution frame batch

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Real D3D9 SM3 packed/float declaration converted to D3D11 FLOAT4 signature and native indexed/nonindexed draw input; HMD UNTESTED.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Unrecognized decl type/stream/offset/stride fail closed; exact index and ordinal admission remain mandatory.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Source vertices captured at live game interception flow through typed unpack, translated IA layout, GPU vertex upload and native Draw/DrawIndexed.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Require matching real-game executable/menu-car-race source draw and native published frame counts >0 in one real-game test before claiming visual completion; currently UNTESTED.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: DX11 full game output remains opt-in; unknown stream/decoder/shader/resource rejects to original D3D9 renderer, input and FFB; no DXVK edits.
